title: OpenClaw Skills for Developers: 8 Workflows That Automate Repetitive Dev Work
summary: OpenClaw skills automate the repetitive developer work — GitHub PR reviews, CI monitoring, dependency alerts, and documentation — 24/7 without you at the keyboard.
body_markdown: GitHub Actions runs scripted steps on fixed triggers. OpenClaw runs an AI agent that can reason, chain tools, and respond to context — not just execute predefined steps. When a build fails, a GitHub Action can notify you. An OpenClaw agent can read the log, identify the likely cause, trace it to a recent PR, and post a specific hypothesis — without you writing that logic explicitly. Think of Actions as if-then rules; OpenClaw skills as judgment.
